topic: A person discovers their child has the same teacher they had
text: When I learned that my child has the same teacher I once had, it was like finding a familiar page in a well-lost book. The classroom, now a bridge between our years, seemed to echo with the seamless passing of time. I could almost hear the chalk against the board, the gentle hum of old lessons. It felt right, as if the circle had simply widened to include another generation. Walking my child to school that morning, the path seemed a little more welcoming, the air a little clearer. It’s a comfortable thread in the tapestry of our lives, connecting the past with the present.
